$comment: Public keys of the agent Workers (ADR 0018), pinned per caller. Each Worker's keyholder Durable Object generates its own Ed25519 key; only the public half is committed here, by a reviewed pull request (the rotation workflow opens it). At most two active keys per caller, during a rotation. A rotated-out key moves to `retired` (kept for verifying old audit records); a compromised key is deleted, never retired. The broker authenticates with `callers`; the gateway's /verify reads this file at build time, never from the broker. Empty until the first agent moves to its own Worker.
